name: Extension marketplace
description: Browse resource manifests and download host-pinned official plugins from GitHub.

features.name: 从官方插件仓库（GitHub）按需下载、校验并安装官方可选插件
features.nameEn: Download, verify and install official optional plugins on demand from the official plugin repository on GitHub

features.name: 可信资源清单市场浏览
数据 manifest 安装、升级与移除
features.nameEn: Data manifest install, upgrade and removal

features.name: 插件市场清单只读校验与原子升级
features.nameEn: Read-only manifest validation and atomic upgrades

features.name: 插件组合 profile 档位
启用已导入扩展包：把技能和提示模板登记为技能与命令插件的资源，可随时停用
features.nameEn: Activate imported packages: register their skills and prompt templates as resources of the skills and commands plugins, reversible at any time

features.name: 通用扩展包导入：按包类型预览、导入与移除，类型由所属插件提供
features.nameEn: General package import: preview, import and remove by package type, each type provided by its owning plugin

features.name: 插件创建与非执行清单校验
features.nameEn: Plugin creation and non-executing manifest validation
